summary: The default InfoBufferSize is now built with resource.MustParse("0") instead of NewQuantity(0, DecimalSI) plus a String() call to prime the cache. Since ParseQuantity now caches the string itself and String() no longer mutates, the resulting value is the same (0, DecimalSI, cached "0"), so a line-by-line review can be skipped.
headline: Default InfoBufferSize built via MustParse instead of NewQuantity plus String()
reason: Produces the same zero DecimalSI quantity with cached string "0"; the removed String() priming is replaced by ParseQuantity caching in the same PR.
